# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen in early September of Nell's first school year (around 14-18 across Volumes 1-3)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c40 P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 c41 P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025)</sub>
- **Rank:** Student; Academy Graduate; Teacher; College Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c36 P39](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Pale Sands; Student at Wexcombe College; Newspaper office worker  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain of the Freshman football team  <sub>[v2 c25 P6](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0006)</sub>; President of the Freshman Class  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>; Medalist  <sub>[v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is described as a tall, handsome youth with wavy chestnut or dark brown hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, and a broad, open-faced look. He has an attractive, mocking grin and a firm, magnificent chin. In his early twenties, he is tall, manly, and broad-shouldered.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)_

## Personality

Hugh is playful, mischievous, and fond of teasing girls, yet he possesses a strong sense of honor, fairness, and responsibility. He is fiercely competitive and ambitious in his studies, but remains generous, friendly, and quick to acknowledge the merit of others. Deeply principled and determined, he works hard toward his goals and shows great self-restraint and maturity. He holds a sincere desire to contribute to humanity and battle against illness and ignorance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P39](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0039), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)_

## History

Hugh grew up in Brierley and spent three years in Alberta with his ailing father before returning to attend Brierley school, where he competed fiercely with Nell Harcourt for top academic honors. He taught at Pale Sands school after advancing to the fifth class and passing his entrance exams. Alongside Nell, he co-founded and led the Brierley Village Improvement Society to beautify the community. Hugh earned a First Class teaching license at Regent's Academy and won the academic Medal. Upon learning that Nell needed to stay near home, he selflessly withdrew his application for the Brierley school so she could be appointed, taking a teaching position at Pale Sands instead. After entering Wexcombe College, he became Freshman Class President and Captain of the Freshman football team, later earning High Honors in Classics and the prestigious Cooper Prize. He worked at the Daily News office in Portmaris to fund his studies, intending to become a doctor. After enduring a near-fatal bout of typhoid fever, he recovered and eventually proposed to Nell Harcourt in Dinah Wren's garden, gaining her love and a promise of marriage.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c29 P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c25 P6](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0006), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c23 P23](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0023), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 c41 P35](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0035)_
